review_scope: Read-only preview seals, exact source-design identity, selected science parameters and final decision; one bounded static inspection of actual preflight numerical coverage. Does not certify actual PCA, model initialization or numerical execution.

method_checks.canonical_original_features_preserved: Input contract and prior sealed real-input review; different teacher PCA coordinates are not combined as training inputs.

A.initialization: read-only old four-member weights; fresh warm start for round1 and final fits

B.initialization: fresh initialization for all four members in round1 and final fits
B.projection: fit current-stage training split only; refit on combined rounds for final stage

loss.average_order: within valid distinct candidates/pairs, then across source groups

method_checks.PCA_and_bootstrap: 600 unique valid train sources; task-stratified source bootstrap draws 120 per task, total 600. Development excluded from PCA, bootstrap and optimization.
method_checks.selection: Original fixed development bank, 95 effective cuts plus 5 common outcomes, planned denominator 100; unchanged candidate and checkpoint criteria.

actual_preflight_numeric_scope.canonical: All 13 probabilities and action-gradient slots 0/11, member and ensemble, same-shape export/reload strict bit equality.
actual_preflight_numeric_scope.dense: Both actual train and development effective source sets; report exact or observed differences, no new atol/rtol or toy-derived bound.
actual_preflight_numeric_scope.static_evidence: final_training_pipeline_v1.py:365-369 loops over train and development for audit_reload, batch_singleton_diagnostics and _dense_ok; load_preflight also rechecks both purposes.
actual_preflight_numeric_scope.actual_numerical_results: pending real preflight; metadata preview is not a numerical pass

method_checks.historical_design_metadata: The exact bound design retains round1 status and READY v5 precedence text as source history. Actual specification phase is final, stop_after A/B=4000, with two true collection protocols. Final READY/config/freeze governs authorization; historical text grants no new operation.
method_checks.decision_assessment: No unintended science or numeric changes found. Decision alone releases nothing; proposed final_fit_preflight is simulator=0 and optimizer=0. Actual fit, policy rollout, calibration and heldout remain separately gated. Fixed numeric runtime remains CPU float32/two threads; the generic GPU lifecycle reminder is not a runtime override.

limitations: No raw trajectory or full dataset re-audit; prior immutable real-input review retained.
No actual PCA/model numerical execution; actual final preflight must provide its own sealed results.
No READY, frozen configuration, source code, thresholds or existing analysis files changed.
